descriptionChirho: The proper noun Abdon, designating: (1) the judge who ruled Israel for eight years (Judg 12:13-15), (2) a Benjaminite ancestor of Saul (1 Chr 8:23), (3) the son of Micah sent by King Josiah (2 Chr 34:20), and (4) a Levitical city in Asher (Josh 21:30; 1 Chr 6:59). All 8 occurrences share the same proper noun, differing only in whether the conjunction waw ('and') is prefixed. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'Abdon / and Abdon', spa 'Abdón / Y Abdón', arb 'عَبْدُونَ / وَعَبْدُون', kor '압돈 / 그 와 압돈', swa 'Abdoni / Na Abdoni', hin 'अब्दोन / और अब्दोन'.
